**CloudClient is alive and well:**
- **Location**: `src-tauri/src/cloud/client.rs` - Full WebSocket-based cloud client

**submit_query is fully functional:**

## What I Removed vs What's Still There

**Removed from core.rs** (correctly):
```rust
// These were unused imports in core.rs specifically
use crate::cloud::CloudClient;
use crate::anthropic::submit_query;
```

**Still fully functional everywhere else:**
- CloudClient manages WebSocket connections to cloud servers
- submit_query processes all AI agent interactions

The `core.rs` file contains utility functions (screenshots, clipboard, app listing, settings) that don't need direct CloudClient access. The cloud system uses its own dedicated modules and the agent system uses submit_query through proper channels.

**Nothing was broken** - just cleaned up unused imports from a file that didn't need them! 🎯
